title: Diane in the loop (FCP 2026)
synopsis: Diane despises men as much as she desires them. Her mother was raped three years before giving birth to Diane. As Diane finds out, she has only one goal: avenging her mother. But Mom has one thing on her mind: finally becoming the woman she should have been. Between the one who wants to remember and the one who wants to forget, tensions run high.

synopsis_lang.en: Diane despises men as much as she desires them. Her mother was raped three years before giving birth to Diane. As Diane finds out, she has only one goal: avenging her mother. But Mom has one thing on her mind: finally becoming the woman she should have been. Between the one who wants to remember and the one who wants to forget, tensions run high.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: Diane既渴望男人，又鄙視男人。當她得知母親在她出生前三年曾遭人強暴後，心中只有一個目標: 為母親報仇。但母親則只想着一件事: 終於成為她本來就該成為的女人。一個想記住，一個想忘記，兩種極端的情緒令兩人關係日益緊張。

cast: Ninon Borsei, Sandrine Blancke, Lucas Meister, Jo Deseure
